description: An untrusted URL redirection vulnerability exists in Telerik UI for WinForms versions prior to 2026.4.1111. This flaw allows attackers to launch arbitrary operating system protocol handlers with attacker-controlled arguments by using crafted documents and hyperlinks containing non-allowlisted URI schemes that a user opens.
